citations.assessment: The checked Bavli directly gives the form Kappotqaa and the argument from scales on birds’ legs.
The checked Yerushalmi gives Kappodqya in the impurity objection, without a title.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The exact speaker occurs at Pesachim 6:5:4 in the checked numbering.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: R. Avin in the name of R. Shmuel Kappodokya is explicit in the comparison of chicken feet to fish scales.
The checked Yerushalmi gives R. Yonah reporting R. Shmuel Kappodokya in a split attribution with another rabbi.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: Yerushalmi Berakhot has a passage in which Ḥaggai identifies himself as Shmuel Kappodokya’s wedding attendant. Treat this as a contextual match to the bare notice.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: The checked Yerushalmi Pesachim numbers this Kappodokya report 6:5:4. Heilprin cites halakhah 7.
In Yerushalmi Berakhot 2:6:5, R. Ḥaggai describes himself as Shmuel Kappodokya’s wedding attendant. Heilprin gives the name alone.
